Name: Bela Dimitrescu in Stardew Valley
Author: SiameseBeauty
Description:
( Victor is Olivia's son, which if you use my sprites of Alcina which replace Olivia, it might be odd for Victor to still be around in the same role as her son. ':) )
You will need "Stardew valley Expanded" in order to meet Victor!
Then,to see sprites and portraits to put these in, enter:
Stardew Valley -> Mods -> Stardew Valley Expanded -> [CP] Stardew Valley Expanded -> assets -> CharacterFiles. You will see folders OverworldSprites and Portraits. Find "Victor" folders in there, and replace his portraits and sprites with Bela Dimitrescu's. (OverworldSprites is where you put sprites, Portraits - Portraits ) Take out Bela's portraits and sprites out of these downloaded folders and replace Victor's in those folders. If it asks to replace the file since it already exists, say yes. You can do a backup of Victor's if you decide to ever return him, then you won't need to replace anything. Simply put these files in the folders.

Since nothing else but the sprites and portraits are edited, Bela plays a bachelor role, instead of a bachelorette.

As always, please credit me if you use my art for your projects.
